Title: Ice Cream Flavors of the Diaspora
Description: Modern ice cream production and the plants that create some of our favorite flavors are possible thanks to the brilliance of Black and Indigenous people. During this session we’ll learn about the contributions of these people alongside the stories of plants like vanilla, sorghum, sorrel, and blueberries as we create ice creams infused with their flavors. If you want to develop your ice cream making skills and plant knowledge you won’t wanna miss this session!

Title: Bird Friendly Garden Management Workshop
Description: Join GreenThumb and Audubon for From the Ramble to the Garden: Bird-Safe Habitat Practices. This bilingual English/Spanish walking workshop uses The Ramble in Central Park as an outdoor classroom for learning how community gardens can better support birds and urban wildlife. Participants will explore bird habitat through guided observation, sound-based activities, and three ecological themes: water, food, and shelter. Along the route, we will connect what we see in The Ramble to practical community garden actions, including native planting, clean water sources, leaf litter, habitat corners, safe pruning, pesticide-free care, and reducing disturbance. The workshop will also include time for reflection, networking, birdwatching, and a poetic closing activity called The Heart of Feathers, during which participants will leave with personal commitments and practical resources to bring back to their gardens.

Title: 2026 NYC Charity Turtle Race
Description:
NYC's pet turtles are racing to support grassroots ecology education, local turtle rescue, and native turtle rehabilitation programs!


This is different ﻿from traditional turtle racesin which illegally captured wild turtles are often exploited and harmed. In our NYC Charity Turtle Race, only legally obtained and responsibly kept turtles compete in a turtle-friendly tournament that benefits less fortunate turtles and promotes grassroots ecological education.

Title: Third-world duplication: Filipino Risograph
Description: We heard you NYC! We’re bringing our Third-world duplication: Filipino Risograph talk to NYC through the Tropik Talks series organized by @neue.sans.press on July 12 from 1-4pm at Accent Sisters. Our lecture will also be featured with another talk by friend and artist @hotemogf about @develo.ph. 🌴 Tickets available in bio for $20 and includes both lectures. 📝 Is print really dead? Our talk explores the overarching importance of Risograph in Metro Manila’s print shops and its influence in Filipino politics, religion, education and more. We will also talk about the impact small publishing has in Filipino history and revolution and the importance of archiving third-world ephemera. 🧾 Thank you to Erin for inviting us, our interviewees (Blessings Print Shop, Jo Malinis, Ginoe, and PH Labor Archive), our interviewer Tommy, Micah Rimando, and Reina Adriano! Video by @annasshole and Tropik Talks Poster by @neue.sans.press

Title: Community Care Clinics For Chronically Ill & Disabled Movement Folks
Description:
🌠🔭 Save our upcoming dates for: Community Care Clinics for Disabled & Chronically Ill Movement Folks - An ongoing community care peer support space aimed at expanding possibilities around how we live and work as disabled and chronically ill people.

🔗 Register here: PeoplesHub.org (link in bio)

• Please join us in creating this community care peer support space.

• There is a particular reality around what it means to be disabled and engaged in movement and social justice work.

• The space will be animated by questions such as:
 - What does it mean in our activism, in our movements, in our work and in our communities to be all in?
 - What sacrifices are inherent, what do we gain, what do we give up and what is expected of us?
 - Am I worthy, do I have the ability to be in the movement, do I have a place here?

*These clinics are ongoing meeting spaces. Please drop in and out as needed. Registering for the clinic space does not mean you must show up for every date. You are welcome to drop in and out of this space.
